2607.25663.title: Localized Adaptation Reveals Distinct Learning Signatures in Transformers
2607.25663.paper_summary: Transformer adaptation is typically distributed across model depth, even when the intended change is narrow. We investigate how adaptation site shapes what a model learns, how well that learning generalizes, and how selectively it is applied. We introduce a controlled benchmark spanning five objectives (lexical binding, factual association, behavioral policy learning, causal mapping, and procedural reasoning) and define each objective's "adaptation geometry" as its profile of acquisition, transfer, and boundedness under full-stack and early-, middle-, or late-layer LoRA. The objectives exhibit distinct geometries. Lexical binding favors early-layer adaptation for acquisition and boundedness but requires broader updates for transfer; factual association favors later layers among localized adapters; behavioral learning separates late-layer action acquisition from middle-layer policy gating; and causal and procedural transfer benefit most from middle- or full-stack adaptation. These patterns largely persist under parameter-matched controls, and most corresponding directional contrasts replicate across five model families. These findings establish adaptation site as a key design variable for controlling what models learn, generalize, and leave unchanged.
2607.25663.paper_summary_zh: Transformer適應通常分佈在模型的深度上，即使所需的變化很狹窄。我們研究適應位置如何影響模型的學習，這種學習的泛化程度，以及它的選擇性應用。我們引入了一個涵蓋五個目標的受控基準（詞彙綁定、事實關聯、行為政策學習、因果映射和程序推理），並定義每個目標的「適應幾何」為其在全堆疊和早期、中期或晚期層 LoRA 下的獲取、轉移和有界性概況。這些目標展現出不同的幾何特徵。詞彙綁定偏好早期層的適應以獲取和有界性，但需要更廣泛的更新以進行轉移；事實關聯偏好在局部適配器中使用較晚的層；行為學習將晚期層的行動獲取與中期層的政策閘分開；而因果和程序轉移則最受益於中期或全堆疊的適應。這些模式在參數匹配的控制下大致持續存在，並且大多數相應的方向對比在五個模型系列中重複出現。這些發現確立了適應位置作為控制模型學習、泛化和不變的關鍵設計變數。
2607.25663.author: Rebecca Ramnauth et.al.
